transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?
Well, hello. My name is Magin. It's a bit hard to talk about, but I keep eating in the evenings until I’m so full it’s uncomfortable, even when I don’t really want more.

Over the past two weeks, have you been feeling down or hopeless most days, or have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy? Also, do these evening eating episodes happen without behaviors like vomiting, laxatives, or excessive exercise afterward?

No, I don't do any of that like vomiting or taking laxatives; I just sit in my recliner feeling physically miserable, staring at the empty containers and beating myself up. I do feel really down, ashamed, and sluggish—even turning down invites from my buddies—but I haven't lost interest in everything, since I still enjoy fishing and gardening during the day.

When these evening eating episodes happen, do you feel unable to stop or control how much you eat? Do you ever wake up during the night to eat, or is it only after your evening meal before going to sleep?

Yes, once I start picking at things after supper, it's like something else takes over and I just can't stop, even while I'm telling myself, "Magin, stop." It only happens in the evening before I go to bed; I don't ever wake up in the middle of the night to eat.

During these evening episodes, do you eat an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time, like much more than most people would eat? Or is it more that you keep nibbling or grazing for hours even if the total amount isn’t that large?

It's definitely a huge amount eaten very fast, not just grazing. After a normal dinner, I'll stand at the counter shoveling in leftover roast, half a loaf of bread, and ice cream straight from the tub like I'm on a tight delivery window. It's all gone before I even realize it, which is way more than anyone I've ever driven with would eat in one sitting.
How often do these evening binge-eating episodes happen—about how many times per week? And for how many months has this been going on?

These eating spells have been happening pretty much every night, at least several times a week without any real break. It's been going on for about three months now, starting right around when my divorce was finalized and I transitioned off the road into this office job.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports recurrent binge-eating episodes characterized by eating an objectively large amount of food in a short period, loss of control during the episodes, marked distress/shame, and frequency of several times per week for about 3 months. He denies compensatory behaviors such as vomiting, laxatives, or excessive exercise. The pattern is therefore most consistent with binge-eating disorder, classified in ICD-10 under other eating disorders.
